title: Delinquency-Length Share of Good-Standing Coverage on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The next-period coverage collected with a good-standing payment on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement carries a delinquency share, counted in calendar days from the agreement's delinquency date to the handling date:

| Calendar days delinquent | Share of the coverage |
|---|---|
| fewer than 6 | 80 percent |
| 6 to 9 | 90 percent |
| 10 or more | the whole amount |

The share multiplies the coverage before it is rounded to the cent, half up, once. The delinquency date is the date on the rental agreement record: the due date of the oldest unpaid billing period of the current delinquency cycle.

## Edges (hypothetical delinquency date 1 May)

| Handling date | Days delinquent | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 6 May | 5 | 80% |
| 7 May | 6 | 90% |
| 10 May | 9 | 90% |
| 11 May | 10 | whole amount |

## Worked figure
Coverage of $144.00 at a 90 percent delinquency share is $129.60 before the single rounding to the cent.
